Yes to Hannah for Saturday 1 to 4. For a rainy afternoon with Jun and Leo, I'd set up a blanket-fort build-off, a living-room obstacle course with cushions, and a Lego or cardboard challenge with a snack break and a movie as the closer, so there's a plan for each hour.
Action: Text Hannah a yes for Saturday 1-4, add it to the calendar, and put together a simple hour-by-hour indoor schedule for the boys.

I'd help Marcus put numbers on it: ask what the 10% is in actual after-tax dollars and set that against the extra commute, roughly 70 minutes a day on the subway versus a 10 minute bike ride. After that, caseload, mentorship and room to grow matter more than the pay gap, and the bike ride is free time and exercise back. If those are close, I'd tell him the closer clinic wins; if the higher-paying one clearly offers better mentorship or a path up, the money is worth the commute.
Action: Draft a short reply for you to send Marcus with those three questions for him to answer.

Added.
Action: Create a recurring Tuesday 17:30 event for Leo's swim lessons at Pam McConnell Aquatic Centre, Regent Park, starting tomorrow.

I don't have that earlier recipe conversation, so I won't guess the quantities. Triple every ingredient on the bag's one-dozen recipe, and use the same oven temperature and bake time, in batches so the trays aren't crowded; I'll give it all in grams and millilitres, with the oven in Celsius.
Action: Send me a photo or the ingredient list from the bag and I'll put the tripled metric version in your notes.

I don't have tonight's puck drop, so I'll check rather than guess.
Action: Look up tonight's Leafs game time and channel, then tell you so Sam can plan around Leo's bedtime.

On it. I'll only accept the Purina Pro Plan Sensitive Skin & Stomach Salmon formula, and I'll read the ingredient list to make sure there's no chicken before I add it to the cart.
Action: Find the listing, confirm it's the salmon flavour with no chicken, and reorder the same size as last time.

I don't have your Costco numbers yet, so I can't call it either way. The decision comes down to the renewal fee against what you actually spent there and saved over the last year, plus whether a card or a gas fill-up is also part of the value.
Action: Pull the last 12 months of Costco receipts and card charges, find the renewal price, and give you a keep-or-drop recommendation before it renews.

Yes, pancakes at Hannah's on Sunday at 9 sounds lovely.
Action: Text Hannah a yes, check the family calendar for clashes, and add 'Pancakes at Hannah's' Sunday 9:00.

I'll pull next week together from your calendar and the family calendar so you can plan around it. I don't have it in front of me, so I won't list anything from memory.
Action: Read next week's personal and family calendars and send you a day-by-day rundown with any clashes flagged.

Congratulations on your first half marathon, 2:04:37 on the Toronto waterfront is a big deal, and give Marcus credit for dragging you through it. Friday reminder at 15:00 for the payouts update is set, and I'll pre-draft the five red/amber/green bullets from Linear for you. Friday evenings are protected for pizza and movie night, with Leo picking the movie and Sam making the dough.
Action: Set a recurring Friday 15:00 reminder with a Linear-based draft for #payouts-launch, block Friday evenings as pizza and movie night, and save the race result (Toronto Waterfront 21K, 2025-10-19, 2:04:37).

In Canada, EFT is the broad term for electronic bank-to-bank transfers, and ACH is really the US name for the same kind of batch network. The Canadian equivalent is the batch clearing system run through Payments Canada, so people use ACH and EFT loosely for direct deposits and pre-authorized debits. A wire is a different thing: faster, higher value and final.
Action: None needed.

I don't have a saved list of what Leo is into right now, so I'd rather not guess for Grace. The only recent thing I have is the giant couch-cushion fort, and I don't have a record of his food restrictions or allergies either, so I wouldn't tell her anything edible is safe.
Action: Check your recent messages and notes for Leo's current interests and any food rules, and report back before you answer Grace.

A common rule of thumb is that a curve has flattened when the period-over-period change stays within about 1 percentage point for three or more consecutive periods. Check that the cohort is large enough that the plateau isn't just noise, and look at the level it flattens at, not only the slope.
Action: None needed.

Here's a draft for Priya: 'Hi [client name], thanks for the updated direction on the facade. Because the brief has changed twice since the design was approved, the revised drawings fall outside our original scope, so we'll send a short change order for the additional hours. Once it's signed, we can start on the revisions.'
Action: Save it as a draft for Priya, with the client's name and the extra hours left for her to fill in.

I need both documents to compare them, and I don't have either one in front of me. Once I have this year's renewal and last year's policy, I'll compare the premium, coverage limits, deductibles and any added or removed endorsements.
Action: Search your email and Drive for this year's home insurance renewal and last year's policy, then send you a side-by-side list of what changed.

I'll pull them up so you can see everything at once before tidying.
Action: List all your personal notes created or edited this month, with titles and dates, so you can decide what to merge, archive or delete.

Done on both. The playlist will be Khruangbin and A. R. Rahman instrumentals for tomorrow, and the strength sessions go in as Tuesdays and Thursdays at 6:15 at the Leslieville YMCA, finishing in time for you to be home by 7:15.
Action: End the Wednesday Spin Society series, create the Tue/Thu 6:15 YMCA series starting tomorrow (Tue 13 Jan) with a 'home by 7:15' note, and build the focus playlist.

Booking the onboarding design review with Aisha and Diego for Thursday 26 Nov at 10:00, 25 minutes, with the agenda in the invite: KYC retry screens, empty states, open questions.
Action: Check all three calendars for Thursday 26 Nov at 10:00, then send the 10:00-10:25 invite with that agenda.

You're welcome. One thing from the camp page: the camper health form and the authorized pickup list aren't marked complete on your account yet, and both are needed before day 1 on Mon 29 Jun.
Action: Add a to-do to finish the camp forms alongside the labelling this weekend.

Try this: 'Thirty-one years of making Riverdale better, and it shows. Congratulations, and enjoy having your calendar back.' If Sam wants plainer, he can cut it to just the first sentence.
Action: Text Sam the line to adjust to his voice.

Noted that the three unmatched charges are yours, so I'll mark them reviewed. I don't have the bakery name, size or flavour from last time.
Action: Search your email and card history for the bakery receipt from the last cake, then confirm the details with you before ordering for New Year's Eve.

Here's a text: 'Hannah, thank you so much for the shortbread! Leo ate four, so it was a big hit.'
Action: Save it as a draft and send it when you give the go-ahead.

A Winterlude Saturday with Leo could go like this: skate on the Rideau Canal Skateway in the morning when it's quietest, beavertail break, a warm-up and lunch, then the snow play and ice sculpture areas in the afternoon, finishing early enough for dinner with Grace. The skateway is weather-dependent, so I'd keep an indoor backup, and I'd confirm dates and times once Winterlude publishes them.
Action: Draft the Saturday outline in your notes with the times left open, and check canal conditions closer to the date.

Here's a draft: 'Hi neighbours! Street yard sale this Saturday, Oct 4, 9 am to 1 pm (rain date: the 5th). Set up your tables on your own driveway, and no early birds before 9, please!'
Action: Keep it as a draft until you say post.

Try this: 'I wanted to tell a joke about compound interest, but I'll let it build and give you the punchline next quarter.' It's finance-themed and clean.

Rough, and Tuesday is a long way from Friday. Let's keep today as light as it can be.
Action: Check today's calendar and flag anything that can move later in the week.

Yes, adding both to Thursday's to-do list: Nate's backsplash decision and Leo's Morse Street forms. For May, your note has the Canadian Tulip Festival in Ottawa as an idea to do with Sam's parents; I only saved the idea, not dates, so I'd check them.

I don't have a Lisbon note in front of me. In late December Lisbon is generally mild and often rainy, roughly 8 to 15 C, so layers and a waterproof jacket are the safe bet, but I'll confirm closer to the trip.
Action: Search your notes for 'Lisbon', pull any weather or packing items, and check the forecast closer to the trip.

Yes to Hannah: pickup at 3:30 for pizza and a movie, then back tomorrow morning in time for the boys to walk in together. Leo will need pyjamas, a toothbrush and his comfort item packed before 3:30.
Action: Text Hannah a yes from you and add 'Leo sleepover at Hannah's' to the family calendar, from 15:30 today to tomorrow morning.

Pastel de nata comes from Belem in Lisbon, Portugal, where monks at the Jeronimos Monastery made the custard tarts and sold the recipe once the monastery closed in the 1800s. The bakery that bought it, Pasteis de Belem, still makes them today.
Action: None needed.

I don't have a saved note on how you learn Spanish best or which vocabulary to use, so I won't guess. Tell me the style and level and I'll set up tonight's practice around it.
Action: Search your notes and email for anything about your Spanish learning preferences and tell you what turns up.

Noted: the mid-year performance self-review in Lattice is due Fri 10 Jul.
Action: Add it to your to-do and calendar for 10 Jul, with a reminder on Wed 8 Jul.

I'll book the cleaning with Dr. Lin at Queen East Dental on 22 Apr, late morning if they have it.
Action: Check your calendar for 22 Apr, contact Queen East Dental for a slot around 10:30-11:30, and add it once they confirm.

Saved to a private health note.
- Allergy: penicillin (hives)
- Seasonal allergies: May, managed with Reactine

Five nut-free camp lunches: turkey and cheese roll-ups with cucumber and grapes, pasta salad with cheese cubes and cherry tomatoes, mini bagel pizzas, hummus with pita and veggie sticks, and a ham and cheese sandwich with fruit. Check labels on anything like pesto, granola and baked goods, since they often contain nuts. I don't have what you asked me about Biscuit and the ambulance the other night, so I can't tell you.
Action: Search our earlier chats for the Biscuit and ambulance question and report back.

That sounds cold, and a coat at your desk in May is a bit much.
Action: None needed.

I'd make molten chocolate cakes: Leo can stir the batter, they take about 12 minutes, and you can fill the ramekins that morning and bake them just before dessert, so there's little waiting. They're also alcohol-free, which is safe with Grace, and they won't clash with the Wellington. For January weekend baking with Leo, I'd line up a few easy recipes with a stir-heavy job for him.

I don't have last night's score, so I'll check.
Action: Look up the Raptors' final score and tell you.

I'll build the drill sheet in Mexican Spanish (carro, computadora) around real situations like ordering food, a work meeting and a doctor's visit, with an answer key at the end. It covers ser vs estar for emotions and locations, por vs para, and the subjunctive after cuando for the future, starting with the correction: 'cuando llegue a casa, te llamo'.
Action: Create the drill sheet with about eight items per section and save it to your Spanish notes.

I don't have a note on what you said helps you unwind on weekends, so I won't guess. Tomorrow could stay empty, with nothing scheduled and nothing you have to decide.
Action: Check tomorrow's calendar and flag anything optional you could drop.

An EFT is a batch bank-to-bank transfer through the clearing system. It's cheap and takes a business day or more, and it can be returned or reversed. A wire is a high-value same-day transfer that is final once sent, with a higher fee, so they aren't interchangeable for merchant payouts.
Action: None needed.

I don't have your inspiration saves in front of me, so I'll search for them.
Action: Search your notes, photos, email and saved links for backsplash or tile inspiration, send you what I find, and gather fresh options if nothing turns up, so you can answer Nate before Monday.

Try this: 'Tres tristes tigres tragaban trigo en un trigal. En un trigal tragaban trigo tres tristes tigres.' For a second round, 'Cuando cuentes cuentos, cuenta cuantos cuentos cuentas' has cuando followed by the subjunctive, which is one of your recurring mistakes. Dreading Sunday night before launch week is normal, so a short Sunday-afternoon plan for Monday could take the edge off.
Action: Save both twisters to your Spanish notes, and set a Sunday-afternoon reminder to write your top three for launch week.
